title: Request access to personal records held by Transport for NSW
summary: You can request access to personal records held by Transport for NSW regarding your driver licence, motor vehicle, or trailer.
intro:
To request information about your NSW Driver Licence, motor vehicle or trailer complete the PDF form.

Only the licence holder can be given licence details.

### Restrictions

Only registration information relating to a known registered operator can be provided.

Personal information about a current or previous operator will not be provided as part of a vehicle information enquiry.
who_can_apply: The licence holder must make the request.
what_you_need: The PDF form: Access to Own Personal Records Application

how_to_steps.text: Download the PDF form – Access to Own Personal Records Application.
Attach copies of your proof of identity documents to the form.

external_links.text: Access to Own Personal Records Application

internal_links.text: Submit a notice of disposal for a vehicle
Renew or upgrade a NSW driver licence

faqs.q: Who can access my personal records?
faqs.a: Only the licence holder can be given licence details.

faqs.q: What kind of information can I request?
faqs.a: You can request confirmation of licence details, registration details, vehicle listings, or name or address history.

faqs.q: What information will not be provided?
faqs.a: Personal information about a current or previous operator will not be provided as part of a vehicle information enquiry.
